faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the PAU Senior Research Fellow position is 05-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Sc. in Soil Science/Chemistry/Botany with at least 65% marks and be NET qualified. A B.Sc./B.Sc. (Agriculture) with 60% marks is also acceptable. Ph.D. holders are eligible as per the note in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the PAU Senior Research Fellow job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow post announced by Punjab Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the PAU Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any age-related information.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, which is https://www.pau.edu.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.
